agent2.instruction: Prepare a net worth certificate for Ravi Kumar Sharma as at 31/03/2026 for bank loan purposes
agent2.draft_text:

items.evidence: "for the purpose of Bank loan purposes"
items.reason: The document explicitly states the certificate is being issued for bank loan purposes.
items.name: Purpose Stated

items.evidence: "Assets ... [To be filled] ... Liabilities ... [To be filled] ... Net Worth: [To be computed once asset/liability figures are entered]"
items.reason: The assets, liabilities, and net worth sections are left as placeholders with no actual itemized figures or a computed net worth value, so the substantive content required by this clause is missing.
items.name: Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth Statement

items.evidence: "The client has represented that the information and supporting documents provided for the above statement are complete and accurate to the best of their knowledge."
items.reason: The document explicitly states that the client represented the information/documents as complete and accurate.
items.name: Client Representation

items.reason: A UDIN field is present, albeit blank/pending, which satisfies the requirement per the instructions.
items.name: UDIN

items.reason: A membership number field for the signing CA is present, even though left blank, satisfying the clause requirement.
items.name: Membership Number

missing: Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth Statement
